Container.Name: NextDash
Container.DonateText: Find NextDash useful? Consider supporting the project.
Container.Overview:
NextDash is a lightweight, self-hosted bookmark dashboard that features a minimalist, keyboard-driven interface with extensive customization options, making it the perfect personal dashboard for power users. Based on the excellent ThinkDashboard.
Key features: • Keyboard-driven navigation for fast access to all your bookmarks • Extensive theme and layout customization • Inbox to collect new links fast: triage them, or keep them on a Kept tab and file whole groups later • Health view that finds broken, stale and duplicate links, with uptime monitoring and downtime alerts • Widgets beside your bookmarks: 21 built-in kinds (uptime, feeds, weather, calendar, disks, containers and more) plus a Custom widget for any JSON API • Six interface languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Chinese • Lightweight and fast, no heavy dependencies • Actively maintained with regular releases
Links: • Website: https://www.nextdash.cc • Source code and releases: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash • Changelog: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash/releases • Devlog / release updates: https://www.nextdash.cc/blog • Also available on GHCR: ghcr.io/jordibrouwer/nextdash:latest
Support: open an issue on GitHub via the Support link above. Bug reports and feature requests are welcome.
Container.Changes:
### v1.13.1 (2026-09-22) - Weather widget: fixed a blank tile — v1.13.0 asked Open-Meteo for the extra readings in a way that dropped the current conditions from the request
### v1.13.0 (2026-09-22) - Widgets: a widget set to two columns now shows more, not the same figures larger — the load average behind the processor percentage, the container that is failing by name, used against total disk space, the expiry date of a certificate, what the weather feels like - Widgets: row lists run in two columns on a wide tile, and narrow back to one on a one-column dashboard or a phone - Weather: the forecast request now also carries apparent temperature, wind, humidity and chance of rain - Kept widget: order by most recent, at random or by tag, with each link's address under its title
### v1.12.0 (2026-09-21) - Inbox: Keep (Shift+K) moves a link to a new Kept tab with its note and tags, without filing it on a page - Kept: group by site, tag or age, file a whole group at once, or work through links one at a time; rows suggest where a link belongs and which tags fit - Undo: inbox, Kept, health and Config → Bookmarks changes can be taken back from their toast - Previews and icons: fetching shows progress, waits out rate limits and can be stopped - Logs: Record server log is a toggle in the log toolbar; every line carries a sequence number - New Kept widget; What's new now also shows v1.11.1–v1.11.8
